verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents an official remote MCP server with a getting-started guide. Through it, agents can run read-only and read-write SQL (including the newer query_rw tool), explore schemas, and read/write Guides, and the docs explain how to restrict agents to read-only access. An official local MCP server (mcp-server-motherduck) is also offered for local DuckDB or self-hosted setups, and a probe confirmed the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
